section.title: Introduction and Overview
section.p: Hardware errors are returned when a component of the system can no longer operate and must return a serious failure. The error numbers allocated all have their top 8 bits set to &80 and are reserved in groups of 256. Consult PRM 1-43 for a fuller description.

section.title: Error Messages
section.p: The error numbers used within the machine exceptions are as follows :

value-table.value: Address exception (no longer returned by the OS)
Unknown IRQ (no longer returned by the OS)
Privileged mode stack corruption (detected by PBTS)
Privileged mode stack overflow (abort due to sp below threshold)
Privileged mode stack corrupt (abort due to sp outside valid range)
